csv_scope_of_work: MAC is seeking the professional services of qualified consultants to provide Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Technology continuing consulting services. To be considered for selection, the firm shall demonstrate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, alternative energy technology including geothermal heat pumps, high efficiency equipment, low voltage, telecommunication, building automation systems, systems integration, and fire protection design with a similar sized systems and continuous operations. MAC may choose more than one consultant in this selection to meet the needs of the Capital Improvement Program.

short_description: Continuing airport consulting services for MEP, technology, and related engineering disciplines.

- No clearly defined bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure scope.
- Structural engineering is listed among requested disciplines, but the main scope is mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and technology services.
- Framework-style continuing services arrangement with broad scope and no specific technically relevant structure.
